c74object.name: mqtt.receive
c74object.description: Outputs the messages on one topic filter, like receive across the network.

discussion.p: Text is split into atoms, numbers come out as numbers. An empty message comes out as a bang.
With a wildcard in the filter (+ one level, # the rest), the topic comes first, so that route can tell the senders apart.

A retained message on the topic arrives as soon as the object subscribes. Other receivers of the same filter on the same client get it again then. With retained 0, a receiver skips retained messages and outputs only new ones.
A client also receives what it publishes itself on a topic it subscribes to: MQTT 3.1.1 has no option to prevent it. A message matching two filters of one client can arrive twice.

objarg.name: client
objarg.digest: Name of the mqtt.client to use

attribute.name: topic
attribute.description: The topic filter to subscribe to; + and # are allowed. Changing it subscribes to the new filter.

attribute.name: qos
attribute.description: 0, 1 or 2: the highest QoS the broker uses for this subscription.

attribute.name: format
attribute.description: text: atoms. bytes: a list of integers 0-255. json: a JSON object as a dictionary, anything else as text.

attribute.name: retained
attribute.description: 1: also the stored message a broker sends when the object subscribes. 0: only new messages.

entry.name: left outlet
entry.description: The messages; with a wildcard filter, the topic first.
